datacompleteness.note: Global datacompleteness labels are source annotations and are not used as a substitute for field-level eligibility. The map registry contains the canonical league label; disagreement with the raw player-game league label is recorded, not silently relabeled.

design_diagnostics.condition_reason: the exact nonzero null vectors make the unrestrained column parameterization singular; no finite condition estimate or effect identifiability is claimed. This necessary unsigned support diagnostic does not diagnose rank or identifiability of a later signed antisymmetric counter design
design_diagnostics.design: one row per valid map; columns are intercept, 10 node incidences, 20 canonical ally incidences, and 25 canonical unsigned enemy co-occurrence incidences
design_diagnostics.identity_description: for every node, ally incidence degree equals 4 times node incidence and enemy incidence degree equals 5 times node incidence; three additional block-sum identities tie node, ally, and enemy totals to the intercept. The reported count is not claimed independent.

numeric_spectrum.method: dense eigvalsh of A_sample A_sample^T for at most 256 rows of the sparse map-by-canonical-feature incidence design
numeric_spectrum.rank_scope: Rank, nullity, and singular extrema describe only the manifested sampled row space. They are not full-design numeric rank, parameter identifiability, or a representation-rank selection.
numeric_spectrum.sampling_rule: take the 256 lexicographically smallest sha256(UTF-8 game_id), tie-broken by game_id

design_diagnostics.structural_rank_method: exact maximum bipartite matching on the sparse zero pattern; it is an upper bound on numeric rank and ignores coefficient identities

generator.identity_scope: the generator module bytes plus numerical/dataframe runtime versions; source data bytes are pinned separately

graph_connectivity.scope_statement: unsigned support-graph connectivity only; connectivity does not establish effect stability, signed counter geometry, or identifiability

observation_contract.ally_definition: unordered role-conditioned node pair within one side
observation_contract.cross_team_definition: unordered canonical role-conditioned node pair across sides
observation_contract.date_semantics: source date must be parseable and exactly equal between map and all joined player rows; timezone-naive source timestamps remain naive and no timezone is imputed
observation_contract.patch_semantics: patch is an oe_source_patch_token normalized from the OE numeric field to two decimal places; it is not a verified official Riot patch identifier and no 16.x to 26.x mapping is applied

temporal_overlap.metric: set Jaccard; descriptive support reuse, not interaction invariance
